title: SystemEnergy and CreateDistanceSensor ask mbs.Inspect instead of trying the output functions
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG11.8.18: advancedUtilities.SystemEnergy found bodies and their energies by calling GetObjectOutputBody and GetObjectOutput in try/except, and ComputeSystemEnergies tried the body function first for every object; mbs.Inspect(object, InspectType.ObjectType) says whether it is a body and InspectType.OutputVariables which energies it gives with its parameters. The only other such construct in the library, CreateDistanceSensor, tried GetMarkerOutput(Position) of a marker.
releaseNotes: SystemEnergy and CreateDistanceSensor ask mbs.Inspect for the kind of an object and the output variables it provides instead of trying the output functions
